items.text: Bandits now attack walls ("plink at the walls") and can be engaged by squad repairs after combat
Fighters now circle bandits during engagements
Random bandit spawns added, with defined spawn pools at Oxum's location
New Bradley APC boss mission introduced at an abandoned military base
Players can now demolish rooms and remove kits; demolition requires holding the action button
Construction mode now shows build guides only while actively building
Recycler interaction distance expanded to 3D reach and recycler is now walkable from squad positions
Bow damage increased (stronger bow)
Rocket launcher received utility updates and new recipes
New kit tiers introduced (bags, beds, workbench levels 1‑3)
New ore nodes and junk barrels added as resource sources
Wood armor sleeves added as new equipment
Fog of war implemented as a depth‑based effect, darkening terrain, props and map edges
New island map based on Hapis Island terrain, with sea level adjusted
Squad automatically repairs after combat
Injured soldiers now rest autonomously without player input
Squad leader now selects spotting positions away from doorways for better line of sight
New recycle‑and‑clear objectives at Oxum's location
Resource bar enlarged for better visibility; bottom‑left log added
Free invites enabled for players
Rebuilt Oxum's base with the recycler workshop shutter open and added new leader spots.
Adjusted Oxum's bandits and leader to carry Eoka weapons dealing 3‑5 damage, reducing one‑shot kills against squads.
Added a new Water Treatment Plant mission, unlocked after completing Oxum's; includes a raid centered on the settling tanks and a baked map scene.

Fixed several terrain clipping and placement issues: nuclear missile silo doorway clipping, shore ice spawning over railway tracks, railway tracks being buried or floating due to terrain smoothing, and ocean water appearing inside near‑shore canyons.
Reduced radii, fade distances, and blend map sizes for several monuments (satellite, jungle_ruins_d, radtown, excavator) to eliminate radius overhang and improve terrain anchor generation.
Fixed swimming NPC and simple shark rotation errors that could cause incorrect facing direction.
Corrected turn‑in‑place rotation being applied twice per frame in first‑person view, removing visual popping.
Fixed a null‑reference crash in the water wheel menu.
Added free‑run, free‑look, camera weight adjustments, and a throw arc to the shoulder camera for smoother movement.
Displayed a reload progress bar next to the weapon in the shoulder camera.
Implemented sliding motion when sprinting while ducked in the shoulder camera.
Introduced a server setting to force all players into the shoulder camera, enabled by default.
Added a new extraction raid mode featuring hot‑air balloon extraction points and a 3 km procedural map.
Populated the extraction map with additional monuments, enemies, a countdown timer, and burner‑lit balloons.
Implemented an Outpost hub on the extraction map, providing a loot stash, unlocks, and save functionality.
Enabled loot banking in a stash and automatic raider drops at raid start.
Players no longer become hostile at the hub after raid fights.
Players who are not in a raid are kept inside the Outpost.
Each team now receives its own dedicated Outpost at sea.
Hub unlocks can now be purchased incrementally with held keys and require wood, stone, and metal.
Hub unlocks and upgrades are accessible via the in-game use menu.
Deploying while crafting is disabled to prevent accidental launches.
Players transition in and out of raids behind the loading screen for smoother experience.
Deploying players are positioned on the tunnel hatch when they start a raid.
Team leaders can launch the entire squad together, ensuring synchronized raid entry.
Items now display a scrap value, letting players see loot worth at a glance.
Backpacks determine both main inventory size and safe pocket capacity.
Main inventory space is halved on the extraction map to increase tension.
Safe pocket appears alongside looted items and remains visible while the stash is open.
Safe pocket has its own slot on the inventory screen.
Carried items persist between sessions but are at risk once deployed.
A raid summary page appears after each raid, showing detailed outcomes.
A lift‑off countdown is shown near lit extraction balloons.
Extraction balloons are marked on the map with timers and close sequentially.
Shoulder camera now uses a narrower field of view for clearer targeting.
Body rotation transitions to running are eased in the shoulder camera.
Players now spawn inside a fenced hub yard and deploy from a manhole; the hub has its own map markers and no death screen on arrival.
The hub provides automatic healing and shielding, a ready‑up timer before deployment, and the ability to sell stash rows.
A new supplies shop in the hub sells basic gear and buys items for scrap, with increased payout values and item‑by‑item valuation.
Outpost is removed from the main raid map, making it a separate hub area.
Added a progress board, unlockable furnace, ovens, and a payment panel to the hub for crafting progression.
Buying and selling of Outpost supplies are now unified under a single interface.
Monument guards are tiered by strength; weaker factions now operate under the scientists, and guards receive loot appropriate to their tier.
Guards now take a short amount of time to notice raiders, adding a realistic detection delay.
New scout drones patrol small monuments, emit a visible light, search for players, and have health that can be damaged.
Drones can be heard from greater distances, keep their alarm active longer, call guards to investigate, and have varied patrol routes.
Stash rows now cost 1,000 scrap for the first row and double for each subsequent row; the stash can expand up to four additional rows and scrap stacks up to 2,000.
Stash layout and upgrade controls have been improved for easier management.
Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own specific reward; loot is priced based on its type, furniture contains unique contents, and blueprints now have weight.
Safe pocket items are now counted as carried inventory, and the raid map is cleared after each raid.
Extraction balloons are positioned clear of trees to prevent them from crushing raiders.
Ground vehicles now feature a third‑person chase camera for better visibility while driving.
Fixed third‑person attack alignment
Stopped first‑person weapon shake when in third‑person view
Improved third‑person throwing, grenade controls and launcher aiming
Added accurate third‑person bow arcs and better aiming feedback
Refined bow framing and aligned drawn arrows with aiming guides
Aligned third‑person reload animations and added hotbar action progress indicator
Added material tracking, stash‑funded upgrades and persistent stash sorting
Adjusted compass, crosshair and ping positions for shoulder‑camera view
Enabled aiming at hubs and furniture with the crosshair and displayed waypoint distances
Implemented a plain countdown timer and allowed lit balloons to finish after the raid
Displayed first loot item immediately and removed hotbar outlines for it
Prevented raids from starting without a raid map, avoiding crashes
Added explicit message when "Disable World Prefabs" stops a raid from starting
Improved extraction scavenging, scout combat and waypoint feedback
Gave extraction scouts 3D flight and reactive pivot lighting
Introduced scout drones with exterior searches, 4‑second wind‑up beeps, dodgeable charges, 55‑damage blasts and mid‑fight strikes
Added tiered AI personalities and organic guard responses for extraction
Migrated bandits to Generation 2 AI
Added new Outpost missions and supplier unlocks
Refined missions, added loot reveal and ensured the first loot item appears immediately
Implemented hold‑E mission interactions with movement/camera lock, target‑anchored progress and reset on cancellation
Made ledger and maintenance‑log reads take five seconds and consume repair materials only after completion
Updated mission card UI with compact layout, audio cues, right‑aligned ticks and task transitions
Integrated water‑treatment pipe access for feedline repairs and pressure release, linking repairs to Outpost water supply and medical shop stock
Preserved safe‑pocket contents when loading before the saved backpack
Fixed invisible building blocks that could appear unseen, ensuring structures are always visible.
Resolved catapult projectile clipping off the map, preventing projectiles from disappearing incorrectly.
Fixed Recycle Bin UI bug where dragging items showed an error message instead of swapping, restoring proper item swapping.
Corrected train tunnel entrances, station placement, and ramp connections to prevent them from leading to voids or being blocked, improving train travel reliability.
Fixed door controllers becoming unpaired after door reskinning, ensuring doors continue to function correctly.
Fixed settings dropdowns re-opening after being closed.
Corrected tooltip offset issues that varied with FPS.
Improved third‑person ladder climbing mechanics and setup.
Extended monument ladders and fixed water entry behavior.
Refined ladder movement, contact handling, and performance.
Added stash filters and aligned inventory layout to a grid for easier item management.
Re‑baked Tropical 2 map to fix shore vectors around the boat building station.
Fixed broken coarse height data during map baking.
Increased guard and scout health for tougher encounters.
Enhanced scout combat behavior, including banking, hit reactions, recovery wobble, and damage smoke effects.

2026-11-16.summary: The AI summary for the latest development commits is still being generated. The commit archive was updated successfully; this summary will refresh on the next run.

items.text: Bandits have been upgraded to Generation 2 AI, improving their combat behavior and pathfinding.
A new caretaker NPC now patrols apartment complexes, knocking on rented rooms and using a peephole, adding an extra interactive element.
The server now refuses to start a raid without a valid raid map, preventing crashes and showing a clear error instead of throwing.
Scout drones now emit flashing beeps, can fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and perform mid‑fight strikes, making them a more active threat.
Hold‑E missions now lock movement and camera, tie progress to the target, and reset if cancelled.
Ledger and maintenance‑log reads now take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after the read finishes.
Feedline repairs and pressure release can be performed using the existing pipe‑access pit and valve at Water Treatment.
Items stored in the safe‑pocket are now retained when the pocket loads before the saved backpack.
First loot item now appears during extraction and hotbar outlines are disabled.
Extraction missions have been refined and loot is now revealed before extraction.

2026-11-15.summary:
### AI & NPC
- Bandits have been upgraded to Generation 2 AI, improving their combat behavior and pathfinding.
- A new caretaker NPC now patrols apartment complexes, knocking on rented rooms and using a peephole, adding an extra interactive element.

### Raiding & Missions
- The server now refuses to start a raid without a valid raid map, preventing crashes and showing a clear error instead of throwing.

### Combat & Drones
- Scout drones now emit flashing beeps, can fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and perform mid‑fight strikes, making them a more active threat.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Hold‑E missions now lock movement and camera, tie progress to the target, and reset if cancelled.
- Ledger and maintenance‑log reads now take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after the read finishes.
- Feedline repairs and pressure release can be performed using the existing pipe‑access pit and valve at Water Treatment.
- Items stored in the safe‑pocket are now retained when the pocket loads before the saved backpack.
- First loot item now appears during extraction and hotbar outlines are disabled.
- Extraction missions have been refined and loot is now revealed before extraction.

Third‑person players now see accurate bow arcs and improved aiming feedback.
Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own specific reward.
Hotbar now displays progress bars for timed actions, giving clearer feedback.
Binoculars and scopes are viewable in third‑person mode, improving scouting while staying behind cover.

Third‑person attacks now align correctly, fixing hit registration issues.

2026-11-14.summary:
### Base & Economy
- Stash upgrades now cost scrap (1,000 for the first row, doubling each additional row), stash limited to four extra rows, and scrap stacks increased to 2,000.
- Outpost Supplies can now be both bought and sold from the same interface.
- Loot items are priced by their actual value, furniture has its own contents, and blueprints now have weight, affecting inventory.

### Combat & Weapons
- Grenade controls and rocket launcher aiming have been refined for more reliable throws and targeting.
- Third‑person players now see accurate bow arcs and improved aiming feedback.

### NPC & Rewards
- Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own specific reward.

### UI & Feedback
- Hotbar now displays progress bars for timed actions, giving clearer feedback.
- Binoculars and scopes are viewable in third‑person mode, improving scouting while staying behind cover.

### Hub Features
- Added a progress board, unlockable furnace, retained ovens, and a pay panel to the hub for expanded base management.

### Combat & Mechanics
- Third‑person attacks now align correctly, fixing hit registration issues.
